description: This file is a shell script containing a suite of automated tests for Git branch functionalities. It includes setup commands, test scenarios, assertions, and expected outputs to verify various behaviors of Git's branch management commands.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test scenario expected to succeed, executing the given commands and verifying their success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command and expects it to fail, verifying the failure status.

methods.name: test_ref_exists
methods.description: Checks that a specific Git reference exists.

methods.name: test_ref_missing
methods.description: Checks that a specific Git reference is absent.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Verifies that a pattern exists within a file or command output.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files or variables for equality.

methods.name: test_cmp_config
methods.description: Compares configuration values to expected values.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Runs a command expecting a specific exit code.

methods.name: write_script
methods.description: Creates a script file with specified content, used for testing custom editors.

methods.name: set_fake_editor
methods.description: Sets up a fake editor for automated editing via environment variables.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
